name: MTAC 510 802 MAX (MTAC, 802 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".995 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .510, Grains 802, Minimum Required Twist Standard, Part Number MTAC 510 802 MAX, G1 BC .995 (A.B.), G7 BC ..509 (A.B.), OAL 2.501", Bullet Projection 1.809"

note: G7 BC is printed "..509 (A.B.)"; does not read as a value and is not stored. Minimum required twist is printed "Standard". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.809".
